name: Th Goat Father Coffee
description: a specialty coffee shop in Canggu, Bali, known for its artisanal coffee and fresh baked goods. The cafe offers a variety of coffee, including creative signature drinks like the Iced Charcoal Latte and traditional options like pour-overs, alongside a selection of pastries like croissants.
priceRange: Pastries & coffees ~ Rp 18.000 – Rp 80.000; coffees & speciality drinks ~ Rp 35.000 – Rp 55.000; full light-meal / brunch menu ~ Rp 55.000 – Rp 150.000 per person
